name: Magnetic Interference
description: Magnetic interference field with a per-band domain-wall spectrum — eight wall families, each pinned at its own defect lattice and driven by its own FFT bin — and hysteresis memory: the magnetisation lags its drive and only switches past a coercive threshold, giving real magnetic lag and remanence. Fixes an unguarded ripple loop, state written into extraBuffer[0..1] (the engine's bass and mid slots), and an audio envelope smuggled through texel (0,0) of the feedback buffer.
